name: Financial Instrument Attributes SD 18
definition: Provides additional information regarding security that will be distributed as part of entitlement.

DeclaredDisbursedSecurityIdentification.name: Declared Disbursed Security Identification
DeclaredDisbursedSecurityIdentification.definition: Security identification of the security that is being distributed as a result of a corporate action as declared by the issuer or offeror on the market.
